mapper.select: SELECT b.*,d.code,r.title,r.revision_no,r.status AS revision_status, (SELECT MAX(v.revision_no) FROM sop_revision v WHERE v.sop_id=b.sop_id AND v.status=1 AND v.deleted_at IS NULL) AS latest_published_no FROM b JOIN sop_document d ON d.id=b.sop_id JOIN sop_revision r ON r.id=b.revision_id WHERE b.=#{targetId} ORDER BY b.status DESC,b.sort_order,b.id
mapper.update: UPDATE SET revision_id=#{revisionId},status=1,updated_by=#{actor},version=version+1 WHERE =#{targetId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE SET status=0,updated_by=#{actor},version=version+1 WHERE =#{targetId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status=1
UPDATE SET sort_order=#{position},updated_by=#{actor},version=version+1 WHERE =#{targetId} AND id=#{id} AND status=1
